# AI Content Studio - Active Development Context

## 🎯 Project Overview
**AI Content Studio** es una plataforma integral que combina asistencia de IA para storytelling, biblioteca de assets visuales, y edición automática de videos para content creators. El objetivo es democratizar la producción de contenido de alta calidad mediante IA.

## 🚀 Philosophy & Approach
- **6-Day Sprint Model**: Desarrollo rápido con entregas semanales
- **Viral-First Design**: Todas las features optimizadas para contenido compartible
- **Creator-Centric**: Diseño centrado en workflows de creadores e influencers
- **AI-Native**: Integración profunda de IA generativa (GPT-4, SUNO, ElevenLabs)
- **TikTok-First**: Optimización prioritaria para TikTok y formats verticales

## 🎨 Core Features in Development

### 1. AI Story Director 🎬
- **Purpose**: Asistente de IA para crear narrativas virales
- **Tech**: GPT-4 integration con prompts especializados
- **Output**: Guiones estructurados con shot lists específicos
- **Target Time**: <30 segundos para generar script completo

### 2. AI Auto-Editor ✂️
- **Purpose**: Editor automático que combina clips, música y efectos
- **Tech**: MoviePy + OpenCV + FFmpeg pipeline
- **Capabilities**: 3+ variaciones automáticas por video
- **Target Time**: <5 minutos para video completo

### 3. SUNO Music Integration 🎵
- **Purpose**: Generación de música personalizada para videos
- **Tech**: SUNO API integration
- **Features**: Sincronización con video, múltiples géneros, stems
- **Target Quality**: Royalty-free, broadcast quality

### 4. Multi-Platform Publisher 📱
- **Purpose**: Publicación optimizada para cada plataforma
- **Platforms**: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Twitter
- **Features**: Optimización automática de formato, captions, hashtags
- **Intelligence**: Timing óptimo por plataforma

## 🛠️ Technical Architecture

### Frontend Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 14 con App Router
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS + Headless UI
- **State**: Zustand + React Query
- **Real-time**: Socket.io

### Backend Stack
- **API**: FastAPI (Python 3.11+)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL + SQLAlchemy
- **Cache**: Redis (caching + job queue)
- **Jobs**: Celery (background tasks)
- **Infrastructure**: Docker + Kubernetes

### AI Services Integration
- **Script Generation**: OpenAI GPT-4
- **Music Generation**: SUNO API
- **Voice Synthesis**: ElevenLabs
- **Speech Processing**: Whisper
- **Video Processing**: MoviePy + OpenCV + FFmpeg

## 👥 Target Users & Personas

### Primary: Maya la Influencer (22 años)
- **Platforms**: TikTok (primary), Instagram
- **Goals**: 100K followers, brand partnerships
- **Pain Points**: Time consuming editing, idea fatigue
- **AI Needs**: Speed up editing, trend suggestions

### Secondary: Carlos el Emprendedor (32 años)
- **Platforms**: Instagram Business, LinkedIn
- **Goals**: Lead generation, thought leadership
- **Pain Points**: Time constraints, professional quality
- **AI Needs**: Professional automation, ROI-focused features

## 🎯 Current Sprint Priorities

### Week Focus Areas
1. **AI Integration**: Core GPT-4 y SUNO integration
2. **Video Pipeline**: MoviePy processing optimization
3. **Creator UX**: Onboarding y first-time experience
4. **Platform APIs**: TikTok y Instagram integration setup

### Success Metrics
- **Time to First Video**: <10 minutes para nuevo usuario
- **AI Generation Speed**: <30s scripts, <45s music, <5min video
- **Creator Satisfaction**: >4.5/5 en early beta testing
- **Viral Content Rate**: >10% de content creado debe ser compartible

## 🤖 Agent Collective Status

### Core Agents Active
- ✅ **ai-engineer**: GPT-4, SUNO, ElevenLabs integration specialist
- ✅ **rapid-prototyper**: Viral feature development y creator tools
- ✅ **trend-researcher**: TikTok trends y viral opportunities analysis  
- ✅ **tiktok-strategist**: TikTok-specific optimization y strategy
- ✅ **ux-researcher**: Creator workflow y user experience research
- ✅ **project-shipper**: Creator community launches y go-to-market

### Department Coverage
- **Engineering**: 7 specialized agents (AI, backend, frontend, mobile, etc.)
- **Design**: 5 agents (UI, UX, brand, visual storytelling, whimsy)
- **Marketing**: 7 agents (TikTok, Instagram, growth hacking, etc.)
- **Product**: 3 agents (feedback, prioritization, trends)
- **Operations**: 5 agents (analytics, finance, infrastructure, legal, support)
- **Testing**: 5 agents (API, performance, analysis, tools, workflow)

## 🔥 Immediate Action Items

### This Week
- [ ] Complete SUNO API integration testing
- [ ] Finalize GPT-4 prompt engineering for viral scripts
- [ ] Build creator onboarding prototype
- [ ] Test video processing pipeline performance
- [ ] Creator beta program planning

### Next Week
- [ ] Launch creator beta with 50 selected users
- [ ] Implement real-time AI processing feedback
- [ ] Build multi-platform publishing scheduler
- [ ] Create creator education content
- [ ] Viral launch campaign preparation

## 🎨 Design Patterns for AI Features

### Creator-First Design Principles
1. **Instant Gratification**: Show AI value within 30 seconds
2. **Creator Control**: AI suggests, creator decides
3. **Style Preservation**: AI enhances, doesn't replace creator voice
4. **Shareable Results**: Every AI output should be TikTok-worthy
5. **Transparent Process**: Creators understand how AI helps them

### AI Integration Patterns
- **Conversational AI**: Chat-based interfaces for script generation
- **Real-time Suggestions**: Live AI coaching during creation
- **Batch Processing**: Background AI for video enhancement
- **Progressive Enhancement**: AI improves as creators use more features

## 📊 Success Metrics & KPIs

### User Metrics
- **Creator Acquisition**: 10K MAU in 6 months
- **Feature Adoption**: >60% of creators use AI features
- **Content Creation**: >80% completion rate for started videos
- **Creator Retention**: >40% monthly retention

### Business Metrics
- **Revenue Growth**: $100K ARR by month 12
- **Creator Satisfaction**: >4.5/5 rating
- **Viral Content Rate**: >15% of content gets >10K views
- **Platform Integration**: Successful publishing to 3+ platforms

## 🔄 Feedback Loops

### Creator Feedback Integration
- Daily feedback from beta creators
- Weekly feature performance analysis
- Monthly creator advisory sessions
- Real-time usage analytics monitoring

### AI Feature Optimization
- Performance tracking for all AI services
- Cost optimization for API usage  
- Quality scoring for AI outputs
- Creator satisfaction correlation analysis
